su-ptro-61369244.d:
Job Summary

Prepare, process, control, and monitor the Purchase Order (PO) and contract until goods and/or services delivered completely to Requestor project. Closely coordinate within Procurement Group, Logistics, and project Management group in efficient and effective in order to support company in terms of delivering good practice (QCDSM) to Supply Chain Management process which conform to business ethics and company procedures.

Job Responsibilities

Key
Metric

Conduct procurement tender process from end to end process, starting from vendor assessment, bidder list, invite meeting, request for quotation, clarification, evaluation, negotiation, award, contract, purchase order, expedite delivery, monitor vendor performance, monitor invoicing process until completion process.
High accuracy on the invoicing process from the beginning to the end.

Analyze and process incoming Tender (RFQ) document to ensure that material are correct in grade, standard, quantity, size, and type against drawing or MTO received.
High accuracy on the analysis and RFQ documents.

Search vendor and product (goods and service) as per specification required at locally and abroad sources.
Found the vendor and products accurately

Negotiate price, discount, delivery terms and other commercial and condition to achieve the best quality, cost, delivery, safety, and moral (QCDSM).
Successfully control the QCDSM

Maintain and actively implement SHE programs and responsibility (involve identify, mitigate and monitor SHE risk), including SHE Management System to ensure the effectiveness of the programs conform to official standard, requirements and procedure applied and to confirm the execution of the SHE Responsibility meet the intended outcome
- SHE risk well maintained

- Target Zero LTI

- SHE Management System meets the current ISO 14001, ISO 45001, SMK3 & SMKP standards and requirements

Education

Diploma or Bachelor’s degree in any major

Skill, Knowledge, and Experience

• Fresh graduate can be considered and those with 3-5 years of working experience in similar field will be considered for senior position
• Person of highest level of integrity with strong sense in commercial matter
• Person with high positive attitude, adaptability and initiatives
• Highly independent and reliable person
• Able to work under high pressure, tight deadlines and willing to be relocated to any site upon requirement
• Good interpersonal and communication skills

Certification

• If candidates do not meet the requirements specified in the Education section, evaluation shall be conducted in accordance with KKNI Level 5.

Other Requirements

• SKK Supervisor Konstruksi Jenjang 7 (PUPR)
• BNSP Teknisi Konstruksi Senior

su-ptro-61430544.d:
Job Summary

Supervise maintenance planning activities on site/in the field incl. plan, coordinate, schedule, and monitor all maintenance planning activities in > 1-3 months horizon pertaining to asset project (heavy equipment) in order to ensure all maintenance activities in project are effective and efficient in timely manner conform to the project schedule and budget.

Job Responsibilities

Key
Metric

Supervise and support team and peers by ensuring that all routine maintenance activities for the machines or equipment are appropriately planned (resources, parts, tooling) and scheduled (with Production and Maintenance) so that the work progresses in a safe and efficient manner.
All routine maintenance activities for the machines or equipment are appropriately planned (resources, parts, tooling) and scheduled which led to efficient work progress.

Optimizing the performance of people by having regular coach, mentor process to develop people within planning functionality
The performance is successfully optimized.

Supports team and peers to ensure on time Distributes weekly and bi-weekly scheduled work to the operations and maintenance supervisors and all appropriate standard job plans/packages included, activities are prioritized, managed effectively and are executed to specification on time.
All appropriate standard job plans/packages included, activities are prioritized, managed effectively, and are executed to specification on time.

Provide formal analysis and the derived conclusion on asset performance in relation with actual maintenance plan. It includes ad- hoc or specific analysis requirement e.g. in order to find out the effectiveness of newly implemented improvement program.
Analysis and conclusions are successfully provided and has a significant impact in program improvements.

Maintain and actively implement SHE programs and responsibility (involve identify, mitigate and monitor SHE risk), including SHE Management System to ensure the effectiveness of the programs conform to official standard, requirements and procedure applied and to confirm the execution of the SHE Responsibility meet the intended outcome
- SHE risk well maintained

- Target Zero LTI

- SHE Management System meets the current ISO 14001, ISO 45001, SMK3 & SMKP standards and requirements

Education

Bachelor's Degree of Engineering

Skill, Knowledge, and Experience

• Min. 2-3 year experiences particularly in Heavy/Mobile maintenance strategy.
• Qualifications and certificates in field of trade/required duties
• Conducts mechanical work to PTP and OEM maintenance standars to help achieve high mechanical availability
• Broad knowledge of heavy equipment maintenance
• Good understanding of mechanical availability and correct repair and maintenance methods
• Good understanding of mining requirements and production targets
• Fluent in English, both
spoken and written is an advantage

Certification

• If candidates do not meet the requirements specified in the Education section, evaluation shall be conducted in accordance with KKNI Level 6.

Other Requirements

• SKK Supervisor Konstruksi Jenjang 7 (PUPR)
• BNSP Teknisi Konstruksi Senior

Conduct routine quality control inspections, measurements, and testing in accordance with established procedures. Monitor product and process quality to ensure compliance with defined standards and specifications. Identify, record, and report quality defects or deviations to supervisors for corrective action. Complete quality control checklists, logs, and inspection records accurately and on time. Coordinate with production teams to support consistent product quality.

JAPFA is an agribusiness company that engages mainly in the production of animal feed, poultry breeding, commercial farm, consumer products, aquaculture, and beef cattle farming. Founded in Indonesia and now headquartered in Singapore, we employ over 37,000 people across an integrated network of modern farming, processing and distribution facilities in Indonesia, Vietnam, India, Myanmar, and Bangladesh. We believe our people are the key to staying ahead, and we continuously seek talented individuals to grow with us and contribute to our mission.
